verses.1: Then, the kingdoms of the heavens will be united with those ten virgins. They went forth to receive their lamps from the hand of the bride.
verses.2: Five of them were also priests, and five were also those who took care of the rituals.
verses.3: For they did not take oil with them when they took their lamps.
verses.4: But those who were careful took oil from the tubes, along with their lamps.
verses.5: And everyone else also stood around and watched as the nymph was being carried along.
verses.6: In the middle of the night, a scream was heard. Then, the nymph rushed out to meet him.
verses.7: Then all the virgins rushed there, and they decorated their lamps themselves.
verses.8: And the Moors said to them, “Give us some of your oil, so that our lamps can be lit again.”
verses.9: But the wise ones said, “It may not be suitable for us and you as well. Go instead to those who are selling, and buy for yourselves.”
verses.10: After they had left, the bride came out. The preparations were made, and they went into the room where the wedding would take place. Then, the door was closed.
verses.11: After that, there are also the other virgins. They say, “Lord, open us up!”
verses.12: But the one who replied said, “Yes, I tell you. I don’t know you.”
verses.13: Therefore, hurry up! You didn’t know even what day it was, nor what time it was.
verses.14: For as soon as a person was freed from his bonds, he called his own slaves and gave them what he had.
verses.15: And who gave five talents? Who gave two? Who gave one? Each person received according to their own ability. Then he distributed them. Immediately.
verses.16: The man who took five talents began to work among them, and he also earned five more talents.
verses.17: In a strange way, those two pleased themselves with two other things.
verses.18: And he, having taken the gold, went away and hid the gold of his master.
verses.19: After a long time, the master of those slaves comes there and discusses things with them.
verses.20: And when he came over, he took five talents and said, “Lord, you have given me five talents. Now, I have received five more talents.”
verses.21: The Lord said to him, “Well, you good and faithful slave, I will make you trustworthy in little things, and trustworthy in many things. Go and enjoy the joy of your Lord.”
verses.22: And when he came forward as well, he said, “Lord, you have given me two talents. But I have received two more talents from others.”
verses.23: The Lord said to him, “Good, you servant who is faithful and trustworthy. For a little faith, I will give you many blessings. Go and enjoy the joy of your Lord.”
verses.24: And when he came forward, the man who weighed one talent also said, “Lord, I know that you are a hard person. I know where you do not fail, and I know how you never lose your composure.”
verses.25: And fearing that you might be harmed, I hid your talendon in the field. Now, you have it back.
verses.26: But when the Lord spoke to him, he said, “Wicked slave and fool! Do you not know that I rule wherever I am not present, and I gather those who are not scattered from there?”
verses.27: Therefore, it is necessary for you to put my coins in the boxes. When I come back, I will take my money along with the interest.
verses.28: So, take away from him that talent. And give to his owner ten talents instead.
verses.29: To those who possess something, everything will be given to them, and even more will be given to them. But to those who do not possess anything, only what they have will be taken away from them.
verses.30: And you let the worthless slave be thrown into the darkness outside. There, he will suffer pain and torment.
verses.31: When the son of man comes in his glory, along with all his angels, then he will sit on his throne of glory.
verses.32: And all the nations will be gathered before him. He will separate them from one another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.33: And he will set the sheep on his right side, and the goats on the left side.
verses.34: Then the king addressed those who were on his right side. “Now, you who are blessed by my father, receive the kingdom that has been prepared for you from above.”
verses.35: For I was hungry and you gave me food to eat; I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, but you guided me.
verses.36: Be naked and cover me with your clothes. I’m sick and weak. I’ve been in prison, and you come to me.
verses.37: Then the righteous will answer him, saying, “Lord, when did we ever see you in distress or suffering? Or do we ever hear of you being laughed at or ridiculed?”
verses.38: When then did we become strangers to you, and be led away from you? Or were we left naked and abandoned?
verses.39: When then did we see you being weak or in prison, and come to you?
verses.40: And when the king answered, he praised them. I say to you, whatever amount of these most humble of my brothers you have given me, you have given me.
verses.41: Then, he also rebukes those who are evil. Go away from me, you condemned ones! Go into the eternal fire that has been prepared by the devil and his messengers.
verses.42: For I begged, yet they did not allow me to eat. They ignored me as well.
verses.43: I am a stranger, and you do not guide me. I am naked, and you do not cover me. I am weak, and I’m in prison; yet you do not care about me at all.
verses.44: Then they will also answer, saying: “Lord, when did we ever see you in distress or suffering, or as a stranger, naked, weak, or in prison? When did we ever ignore you?”
verses.45: Then he will answer them, saying, “I tell you, if you have not done even the smallest of these things, then you have not done anything for me either.”
verses.46: And these will be sent to eternal punishment; while the righteous will be given eternal life.
